correctness.rationale: Uniform permutation symmetry and the exact rank-two greedy criterion prove each per-basis normal-cone probability for every class-size vector. Squaring and regrouping gives the closed C2 identity; direct differentiation yields a positive factor times the difference of two class sizes, proving strict Schur-convexity, sharp integer extremizers and asymptotics. The two-face-count pair follows from the standard matroid exchange-edge criterion and exact rational evaluation. Standalone check.py independently enumerates 58 integer class-size partitions through n=8 and 3065 strict transfers through n=15, and reproduces the exact 109-vertex, 1250-edge witness. These computations corroborate rather than prove infinite claims.

value.rationale: The normal-fan angular spectrum is a canonical probabilistic Euclidean invariant for arbitrary rank-two matroid base polytopes; random isotropic linear objectives are natural in polytope optimization. The strict majorization theorem classifies all global extremal class-size profiles and gives different sharp n-scaling regimes. Two polytopes with exactly the same f0 and f1 nonetheless have different exact two-direction collision probabilities, which demonstrates geometric information not contained in those face counts. This is an all-parameter structural classification, not an arbitrary numerical slice or textbook restatement.
